# Bundled fonts

These upright fonts are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Each
font's original license and copyright notice are included beside its font file.
The TTF files are copied without modification from the Google Fonts repository.
License text is preserved with normalized line endings and trailing whitespace.
The application loads these files from this repository; it does not
request fonts from a Google Fonts CDN.

Source repository: [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts). All files are
pinned to commit
[`7085eb89a950e85db5b166b7a58d414544b4140c`](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/7085eb89a950e85db5b166b7a58d414544b4140c).

| --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: |

The six font files total **3,855,012 bytes** (approximately 3.68 MiB). The full
upstream character maps and font metadata are preserved. Every font includes
basic Latin letters, digits, and all Russian Cyrillic letters, including
`Ё` and `ё`. Extended character coverage differs by family.

All six fonts use upright Regular weight 400 by default. Inter, Noto Serif,
Roboto Mono, and Oswald are variable fonts:

| Family | Axis | Supported range | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Inter | Weight (`wght`) | 100–900 | 400 |
| Inter | Optical size (`opsz`) | 14–32 | 14 |
| Noto Serif | Weight (`wght`) | 100–900 | 400 |
| Noto Serif | Width (`wdth`) | 62.5–100 | 100 |
| Roboto Mono | Weight (`wght`) | 100–700 | 400 |
| Oswald | Weight (`wght`) | 200–700 | 400 |
